<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_TransactionDataRequest" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/transaction-data-request">

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RequestToIP" name="Transaction data request" sourceRef="Task_TransmitRequest" targetRef="StartEvent_RequestReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DataToINQ" name="Transmission of data" sourceRef="Task_TransmitData" targetRef="CatchEvent_DataReceived"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_INQ" name="INQ" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_TransmitRequest" name="Transmit transaction data request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_INQ_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_INQ_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_AnswerEvent" name="Answer received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_INQ_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_INQ_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_INQ_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_DataReceived" name="Data transmitted received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_INQ_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_INQ_5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DataReceived" messageRef="Message_TransmittedData"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_RejectionReceived" name="Rejection received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_INQ_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_INQ_6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RejectionReceived" messageRef="Message_Rejection"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DataReceived" name="Data received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_INQ_5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RejectionReceived" name="Request rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_INQ_6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_INQ" targetRef="Task_TransmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_2" sourceRef="Task_TransmitRequest" targetRef="Gateway_AnswerEvent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_3" sourceRef="Gateway_AnswerEvent" targetRef="CatchEvent_DataReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_4" sourceRef="Gateway_AnswerEvent" targetRef="CatchEvent_RejectionReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_5" sourceRef="CatchEvent_DataReceived" targetRef="EndEvent_DataReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_6" sourceRef="CatchEvent_RejectionReceived" targetRef="EndEvent_RejectionReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_IP" name="IP" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestReceived" name="Transaction data request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RequestReceived" messageRef="Message_TransactionDataRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRequest" name="Check request of INQ">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IP_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ExaminationOutcome" name="Examination outcome">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IP_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_TransmitData" name="Transmit data to INQ">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IP_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RejectRequest" name="Reject request to INQ">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IP_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DataTransmitted" name="Data transmitted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IP_5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RequestRejected" name="Request rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IP_6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckRequest" targetRef="Gateway_ExaminationOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_3" name="Examination positive" sourceRef="Gateway_ExaminationOutcome" targetRef="Task_TransmitData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_4" name="Examination negative" sourceRef="Gateway_ExaminationOutcome" targetRef="Task_RejectRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_5" sourceRef="Task_TransmitData" targetRef="EndEvent_DataTransmitted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_6" sourceRef="Task_RejectRequest" targetRef="EndEvent_RequestRejected"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
